representation_convention.variables: Comoving counts N and kinetic energies U; rho=dN/dW. Proper-volume dilution is not added to comoving count equations.
representation_convention.eos: U=c_v N T; c_v=3 k_B/2; common nonrelativistic monatomic ideal thermal gas.
representation_convention.cutoff: c(T)=chi k_B T; c here denotes cutoff energy and not speed of light.
representation_convention.boundary_ownership: Thermal owns W=c; active tail is the open interval (c,infinity).
representation_convention.common_state: C=N_nuc+N_e,all and E=U_thermal+U_active. Binding/radiation ledgers are held outside cutoff reclassification.
representation_convention.candidate_update: Recompute candidate moments from the fixed reference; never accumulate reference-to-candidate transfers repeatedly.

assumptions.statement: Resolved electron measure is nonnegative on W>=0 with finite zeroth and first moments; unresolved base count C-integral(dmu)>=N_nuc>0 and unresolved base energy E-integral(W dmu)>=0.
assumptions.edge_handling: Zero spectral weights are allowed and omitted from atomic sorted groups. Zero nuclei count is outside the positive-EOS theorem. U_B>0 is required by the atomic continuation implementation.

assumptions.statement: A downward cutoff move has an explicit retained lower-band measure or atomic inventory consistent with original thermal count/energy. U,N alone do not determine that measure or its boundary trace.
assumptions.closure_limit: A positive moment-compatible reconstruction is a selected closure, not a proof of Maxwellian or physical trace accuracy.

assumptions.statement: The temperature bracket I=[T_minus,T_plus] is positive, contains the reference temperature, and the resolved measure has no atoms within the moving cutoff bracket. Continuous bounded density gives a classical derivative; bounded piecewise continuous density gives the same absolutely-continuous monotonicity and residual theorem using an a.e. derivative bound.
assumptions.edge_handling: At finite density knots use one-sided piecewise derivatives; at atomic crossings use branch arithmetic instead of the smooth derivative.

assumptions.statement: F(T_minus)<=0<=F(T_plus) and a verified derivative lower bound F_T>=m>0 hold on the bracket.
assumptions.explicit_bound: m=c_v N_min when chi<=3/2; otherwise m=c_v N_min-chi(chi-3/2) k_B^2 T_plus rho_max, or a sharper directly computed minimum.
assumptions.failure_behavior: Do not promote unique root or residual/m certificate when m<=0 or bracket signs fail.

assumptions.statement: Picard convergence additionally requires Phi(I) subset I and a verified global q=sup_I |Phi_T|<1.
assumptions.failure_behavior: Bisection with TC-A4 remains available without Picard contraction. The root-only formula cannot be used as an off-root q certificate.

assumptions.statement: At h=0 predictor data equal the original inventory and spectrum, c0=alpha T_n, and Ubar_0=c_v T_n Nbar_0. For smooth time consistency the fixed-boundary predictor and spectral moments are C1 in h with Ceff_0>0.
assumptions.time_error: C1 gives correct first derivative and o(h) remainder. A bounded O(h^2) local remainder additionally requires locally Lipschitz first derivatives or C2 data and a predictor of matching order.

assumptions.statement: Expansion is prescribed. Counts/spectrum are comoving, and thermal pressure work is -(2/3) theta U. Actual energy drift b_c and jump daughters remain separately source-bound.
assumptions.angle_scope: Use angular-integrated trace and replace b_c rho_c by the angular integral of b_c(Omega)rho_c(Omega) when anisotropic.
assumptions.jump_rule: A daughter born below cutoff carries its actual energy, not the boundary energy.
assumptions.upwind_branch: When lower/upper traces differ, the implicit coefficient is read on a fixed relative-flow sign branch; a sign switch requires rebinding the selected upwind trace.

assumptions.statement: Finite atomic measure has sorted distinct energies and positive group weights. T_k=(U_B+prefix energy)/(c_v (N_B+prefix count)) is an admissible branch iff w_k<=alpha T_k<w_(k+1).
assumptions.existence: For chi>=3/2 and U_B>0, starting with k=0 and including the next node while w_(k+1)<=alpha T_k constructs a positive branch in at most M inclusions.
assumptions.uniqueness: No global uniqueness claim. Enumerate all M+1 branches if the complete root set is needed.

assumptions.statement: Continuation fixes the atomic spectrum and base count, begins from an initial branch obeying the thermal-equality convention, changes only U_B to U_B+Delta U_B>0, and requires chi>=3/2.
assumptions.heating: Start from the inherited index and include increasing energies. Index is monotone; temperature need not increase at each inclusion.
assumptions.cooling: Remove the highest thermal energy while it lies above cutoff. Under chi>=3/2 the resulting temperature decreases and positivity is retained.
assumptions.identity: Delta U_B=0 makes no transfer on a consistent initial branch.
assumptions.regularity: At chi>3/2 an atomic crossing can create a finite temperature jump. Smooth Ceff or C1-in-time results are not applied to such a crossing.

assumptions.statement: Changing spectrum energies or weights after a general reaction predictor requires a newly bound inventory and a stated branch-selection policy. The pure base-energy continuation theorem is not applied to arbitrary spectral changes.
assumptions.feedback_interface: An outer event-capacity map uses the same initial y0 and fixed initial donor mask for every trial. Branch-local nu_N and nu_U, rate derivative bounds, and Ceff>=m are required for root sensitivity; crossings require the separate atomic branch treatment.

claims.outcome: Positive conservative fixed-reference finite cutoff reclassification.
Effective heat capacity; explicit local root existence/uniqueness; conditional Picard convergence.
Algebraic residual and tail/reference input errors mapped to a temperature certificate.
h=0 identity and correct moving-boundary derivative under consistent fixed-cutoff predictor.
Nontrivial continuous spectrum with exact heating/cooling endpoints and rational convergence bounds.
Finite atomic root enumeration and constructive existence for chi>=3/2; exact packet energy/count bridge.
Positive conservative atomic heating/cooling branch continuation with finite termination and h=0 identity.

algebraic_temperature.bound: min(|F|/m, max(T-a,b-T)); at midpoint the second term is (b-a)/2
algebraic_temperature.evaluation_roundoff: For an approximate residual, replace |F| with |Fhat|+eta_F. Exact Fraction fixture has eta_F=0 for its declared rational representation.

data_temperature.limitation: Equality of total spectrum moments does not imply equality of its cutoff-tail moments.

error_map.combined_temperature: algebraic bound + data bound, under a common admitted bracket and original m>0.
excluded: physical ODE time truncation without separately supplied predictor defect
smooth derivative through atomic threshold jumps

implementation_contract.arithmetic: Exact Fraction input; finite box moments and finite atom prefixes.
implementation_contract.root_solver: Bounded bisection; exact piecewise-affine F_T minimum checked for the declared box representation.
implementation_contract.nonconvergence: Return MAX_ITERATIONS with the last candidate, bracket and honest error certificate.
implementation_contract.negative_state_correction: None; invalid domain or inventory is rejected.
implementation_contract.finite_resource_design: Bisection limits iteration count and grows midpoint denominator bit-length linearly; atomic prefixes are formed once and scans change a bounded integer index.

science_scope.kernel_runtime_qualification: Not performed by these closure checks.
science_scope.external_symbolic_evidence: Actual Wolfram/xAct checks are executed and recorded by the parent; no duplicate symbolic run is performed in this subtask.
